competences.description: Attacks the enemy to decrease Defense for 2 turns with a 40% chance. This attack will deal more damage according to your Defense.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.

competences.description: Defends the ally with the lowest HP for 3 turns, then charges towards the enemy target. Deals damage that increases according to your Defense on the attacked target and stuns for 1 turn.

effets.description: The caster of this skill will receive half of the damage inflicted on the escorted target while making the damage dealt to the defended target to 0 and counterattack the enemy target.
The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

competences.description: Deals bonus damage in proportion to the difference between the enemy target's Defense and your Defense and recovers the HP of all allies by 30% of the damage dealt. In addition, whenever you attack an enemy, your Defense increases for 1 turn. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: The target's defense will be increased by 70%.
